purpose: Exact one-generation Standard Model representation data and consistency checks. Convention: Q = T3 + Y.

anomaly_checks_one_generation.SU3_c_squared_U1_Y: cancels after all right-handed fields are represented as left-handed charge conjugates
anomaly_checks_one_generation.SU2_global_Witten: Four SU(2) doublets per generation after color multiplicity is counted (three quark doublets plus one lepton doublet), so the number of left-handed doublets is even.

important_distinctions: The minimal Standard Model has no right-handed neutrino field and gives neutrinos zero mass; observed neutrino oscillations therefore require additional ingredients beyond that minimal field content.
Spin labels spacetime transformation behavior; color, weak isospin and hypercharge are internal quantum numbers.
Hypercharge is not electric charge. Electric charge emerges after electroweak symmetry breaking through Q = T3 + Y.
Gauge anomalies must cancel for a consistent chiral gauge theory. The cancellation is a property of field representations, not metaphysical evidence.
This physics layer must not be used as evidence for angels, demons or supernatural claims.
